items.title: Melba Liston — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: How was it when you wrote with Oliver Nelson? ... Yeah, and I loved his.

ctx.x: Yeah. A little bit, but three or four bars in they’d start over again, and everything’s cool. Not recently or in the last 20 years or something, but before then I think there was some kind of animosity until they got into my arrangements, and they’d say “oo” and they’d start it over again.
It’s like teaching an old dog new trick. How was it when you wrote with Oliver Nelson? He’s a hell of an arranger too.
